parole.significato: missing an arm or forearm; one-armed, or one-forearmed
parole.testo: Borrowed from Pipil kutu (“short, dismembered”) cf. Pipil mākutu (“one-armed, with an arm missing”), related to Classical Nahuatl cotoctic (“dismembered”), macotoctic (“dismembered of one arm”), quechcotoctic (“decapitated”). The DRAE states it is borrowed from a Nahuatl cutuche (“cut”), but this is
From Pipil makwil (“five”) + iswat (“leaf”). Compare with Classical Nahuatl macuilli (“five”) + izhuatl (“leaf”).
